comment: The command bytes the 68010 writes at 600000 for the JSA II's 6502, 00-6C (h_nmi queues any byte 6D or above as 6D, which dispatch_command ignores). name: snd_ + the 68010's own name for the command in its audio test list (audio_test, the 22-byte entry at audio_test_entry in the table at 05C63C: a word, the command, and the name), or cmd_XX_imm for the one command the list leaves out. class, type, param: the 6502's cmd_class (6093), cmd_type (6100) and cmd_param (616D) entries; handler: the 6502 routine that runs it (cmdtype_handlers at 472F by type when class has bit 7 set, else imm_handlers at 61DA entry class+1, inside the NMI). call_sites: every call of queue_sound_command (0301CA) that can queue the command, with the routine around it (site_notes says how a computed value is chosen); direct_sends: the instructions that write it without the queue (the boot program's tests, the audio test, the unreferenced watchdog 03001E). mame: how often each make sndproto run saw it written at 600000; mame_sites: the call sites the runs saw queue it. No ROM bytes: numbers, names and addresses.

types.00: cmdtype_00_min_priority (438A): min_priority = 4 x param. min_priority is a floor on the track priority: while it is not 0 the OKI start returns at once (5BFE-5C01), and a YM2151 key-on needs the track's priority byte sounding_prio >= min_priority (4EE3-4EF0)
types.01: cmdtype_01_set_var (43AD): seq_vars + (global_set_index+param AND 1F) = global_set_value+param; a stream op reads seq_vars,y (54EE)
types.03: cmdtype_03_immediate (43CA): imm_handlers entry param by RTS; entry 0 is init_sound (4238), the initialisation reset also runs: OKI reset (5BAC), response queue emptied, every track freed and the lists emptied, YM2151 key-off on the eight channels, MIX set
types.05: cmdtype_05_stop_sound (43EE): if command param is of type 08, every track playing its sound gets trk_sound = FF (stopped)
types.08: cmdtype_08_start_sound (4569): starts sound param, one track per entry of the list sound_first_entry (first entry) and entry_next (next) give: priority entry_priority, YM2151 channel entry_channel, byte stream entry_stream; sound_restartable says whether a sound still playing starts again
types.09: queue_response (44D0): param goes into resp_queue; main_loop sends it (4164)
types.0A: cmdtype_0A_release_sound (445F): if command param is of type 08, every track playing its sound is released (trk_slide_rate_hi = D0, trk_slide_time_hi = 2, trk_sound = FE)
types.0B: cmdtype_0B_release_priority (4496): every track whose priority (trk_priority / 4) is param is released as by type 0A
types.13: cmdtype_13_oki_play (5BFE): OKI phrase effect_phrase+param on the channel and attenuation of effect_voice+param, unless min_priority is not 0
types.14: cmdtype_14_oki_stop (5C6F): stops the OKI channel whose current phrase is param
types.FF: no type: an immediate command (class 00-03), run inside h_nmi through imm_handlers; dispatch_command ignores type 15 and up (4377-437A)

commands.name: snd_soff
commands.does: priority floor: min_priority = F0 (no OKI start, only priority 3F keys on)

commands.name: cmd_03_imm
commands.does: sends coin_state, read_inputs's four 2-bit coin counters (5D11-5D57; the raw RDIO bits 0-3 when RDIO bit 7, the self-test, is set)

commands.name: snd_smax
commands.does: sends 6D, the number of command values the tables cover

commands.name: snd_stat
commands.does: sends board_status, the status byte, then sets its bits 0 and 2

commands.name: snd_scum
commands.does: sends AA, takes the next byte written and sends it back

commands.name: snd_ftubmus
commands.does: releases every track of priority 27 (the sound of command 0A)

commands.name: snd_fmapmus
commands.does: releases every track of priority 29 (the sounds of commands 0C, 0D, 17)

commands.name: snd_kbrake
commands.does: stops the OKI channel playing phrase 48
